title: Acceleration Conversion
text: Convert from acceleration units to desired acceleration units, 1 input, 1 output, {Initial unit} sets Input unit; {Final unit} sets the output units ft/s^2. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial unit
params.values: Input units ft/s s (default) | m/s 2 | km/s 2 | in/s 2 | km/h-s | mph/s | G’s

params.name: Final unit
params.values: Output units ft/s^2’ (default) | m/s^2 | km/s^2 | in/s^2 | km/h-s | mph/s | G’s
